title: The comfort of agreement
paragraphs: A committee praised its unanimous decision as evidence of rigorous debate. A dissenting observer, however, wondered whether agreement reflected scrutiny or merely reluctance to prolong the meeting.
Her objection did not establish that the decision was mistaken. Rather, it exposed how readily a reassuring outcome can be mistaken for an account of its origins.
Consensus may deserve confidence; what remains unsettled is whether it supplies its own justification.

spans.contextSentenceTr: Aksine, güven veren bir sonucun nasıl kolayca kendi kökenlerinin açıklaması sanılabileceğini gözler önüne serdi.

questions.prompt: How does the writer position the observer’s objection?

options.text: As proof that the decision must be reversed
As a reason to reject every consensus
options.explanation: Son cümle uzlaşmanın güveni hak edebileceğini kabul ediyor.

options.text: As a challenge to the inference drawn from agreement
options.explanation: Sonuçtan sürecin kalitesine gidilen çıkarım sorgulanıyor.

options.text: As evidence that no discussion took place

questions.prompt: What separates the committee’s view from the observer’s?

options.text: They interpret the same agreement differently.
options.explanation: Aynı oybirliği, titizlik kanıtı veya başka bir sürecin sonucu olarak yorumlanıyor.

options.text: Only the observer knows the final decision.
The committee rejects debate in principle.

questions.prompt: What does “an account of its origins” mean here?

options.text: An explanation of how the outcome arose
options.explanation: Sonucun hangi süreçten doğduğunun açıklaması kastediliyor.

options.text: A record of the meeting’s expenses
A prediction of the next decision
An endorsement of the observer’s opinion

questions.prompt: What does the final sentence accomplish?

options.text: It retracts the observer’s entire objection.

options.explanation: Uzlaşmanın güveni hak edebileceği açıkça kabul ediliyor.

options.text: It resolves the uncertainty with a new fact.
options.explanation: Yeni veri sunmuyor, açık soruyu koruyor.

options.text: It distinguishes possible merit from self-validating proof.
options.explanation: Uzlaşma değerli olabilir; fakat yalnız var olması kendini kanıtlamaz.
